mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of triggered instances during monetary easing cycles, or the 20d returns are not statistically significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% triggers a loss of investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.5 percentage points in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX returns remain positive despite UNRATE crossing 5.0% threshold, or the negative return is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) over the 20d period.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices signals economic expansion, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and INDPRO both increase by > 2% in the same month
failure_condition: SPX returns do not follow a positive trend when both GDPC1 and INDPRO are rising, or the correlation between proxy movements and returns is weak (R² < 0.3).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing borrowing costs and enhancing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, FEDFUNDS decline does not correlate with positive 20d returns, or the returns are not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals inflationary pressures, prompting central banks to maintain higher interest rates, which compresses equity valuations and results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns remain positive despite rising CPIAUCSL, or the negative return is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) over the 5d period.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in employment (PAYEMS) exceeding 150,000 new jobs triggers heightened market optimism, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns do not follow a positive trend when PAYEMS crosses 150,000, or the positive return is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both housing demand (HOUST) and general demand (GDPC1) indices signals robust economic activity, boosting corporate earnings and equity values, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and GDPC1 both increase by > 5% in the same quarter
failure_condition: SPX returns do not follow a positive trend when both HOUST and GDPC1 are rising, or the correlation between proxy movements and returns is weak (R² < 0.3).

mechanism_narrative: During tight monetary policy (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%), a concurrent surge in CPIAUCSL (inflation) signals supply chain constraints, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns remain positive despite high FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL, or the negative return is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) over the 60d period.
